visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a chocolate-glazed donut topped with nuts, held by a hand. It then cuts to a man in a blue denim shirt (Host) standing in a studio kitchen with a large bowl of melted chocolate. He gestures excitedly while speaking. (2) A second man (Chef) wearing a brown apron over a light shirt is introduced, holding a measuring jug of white liquid. The background is a bright studio with a whiteboard and curtains. (3) A series of close-up process shots show clear vegetable oil being poured into a bowl, followed by whisking a creamy white mixture. Honey is drizzled into the bowl, and then a white powdery substance (flour or starch) is added and stirred with a black spatula. (4) The Host and Chef are seen talking and laughing while stirring the thick batter together. (5) The batter is transferred to a small green cup and then piped into a red silicone donut mold. A shot of the donuts rising inside a glowing oven follows. (6) The baked donuts are dipped into melted dark chocolate and sprinkled with crushed nut pieces. (7) The Host takes a large bite of a finished donut, looking surprised and satisfied. Graphic overlays showing a hexagonal 'Golden Formula' and various other desserts appear. (8) The video concludes with the Host holding a plate of donuts and pointing to promotional text for an online baking course, followed by a montage of dessert photos.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice introduces the low-calorie dessert concept over upbeat, bright acoustic pop music with a steady guitar rhythm. Subtle whoosh SFX accompany visual cuts. (2) Second male voice enters with a calm, informative tone, explaining the use of soy milk as a dairy alternative. Background music continues at a consistent volume. Clear articulation and studio-quality recording are maintained. (3) Percussive sounds of ingredients being poured and whisked are audible beneath the dialogue. The tempo of the background music provides a rhythmic bed for the instructional speech. (4) Brief laughter and conversational banter between the two men occur during the mixing phase. Vocal pitch rises slightly during expressive reactions. (5) A sharp mechanical click sound accompanies the baking sequence. Music swells slightly during the transition to the final product reveal. (6) A distinct crisp crunch sound is heard as the host bites into the donut, followed by enthusiastic exclamations of 'Wow!' and positive feedback. (7) Promotional narration regarding the online course begins, delivered in a professional yet persuasive tone. Music fades slightly into the background but remains present until the end of the video.
